cards.issue_title: Both “Zero” lines show at once while scrolling, so the page looks broken
summary_4_lines: When you scroll through the Zero commissions / Zero bias block, both giant “Zero” words sit on screen together.
The extra words (commissions, bias) are missing in that moment, so it can look like the site is broken.
They wanted one Zero at a time: first Zero commissions, then Zero bias, then the next sentence.
If there is nothing left to show, they said the page could just let people explore.
cards.pinpoint: On the homepage Zero commissions / Zero bias block, scrolling shows both large “Zero” words at once without commissions/bias, which they said makes it unclear whether the website is broken; they wanted sequential reveal (first Zero commissions, then Zero bias, then the next sentence).
cards.on_screen_object: h2#home-zero-title “Zero commissions. / Zero bias.” full-page story block
quotes_sample: So, in this section, I found the problem that when you scroll up, you can see both the zeroes.
And you don't know if the website is broken or not.
Or if there is nothing to show, you can explore.
related_discussion_one_liners: Opening “Just give me 9 minutes.” / “9 minutes?” is session setup, not a site defect.
After this they stay on the same block and attack the words commissions and bias (issue 02) and the small supporting sentence (issue 03).
“Or if there is nothing to show, you can explore” is their fallback if a sequential reveal has no next beat.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the mid-scroll layout glitch where both giant Zero words show at once without commissions/bias, not the meaning of those words, the supporting line, Best of all copy, four-section count, or journey sentence formation.

cards.issue_title: “Zero commissions” and “Zero bias” mix bank and customer, so the words are unclear
summary_4_lines: As a customer, “commissions” first sounds like a fee taken from you, not a fee from the bank.
Then “Zero bias” asks you to switch meaning: now it is about not pushing any bank.
The block never says whether this whole stretch is website-and-bank or website-and-customer.
They said that mix makes the section hard to understand.
cards.pinpoint: On the homepage Zero commissions / Zero bias heading, “commissions” is read as a fee taken from the customer, then “Zero bias” forces a switch to website-and-bank (not pushing a bank); they said the section mixes those two contexts and is not easy to understand.
quotes_sample: when I read the word commissions, I feel, instantly as a consumer, I don't know which commission I am talking about.
What does this do? It doesn't make it easy to understand.
Somewhere, it should be said that either this whole section is about website and bank, or this whole section is about website and customer. It should not be mixed in the context.
related_discussion_one_liners: They then explain the intended gist: we don’t take commission/money from the bank, so we have no bias to push a bank; ranking is customer benefit; no one can pay to change ranking — content they want in the last sentence (issue 03).
“At least in Shroffin, in polished English, we have to convey this gist” and “96% or 98% conversation can be done in just 300 words” is how they want the words written, not a second defect.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the commissions/bias wording mixing customer-fee vs bank-push contexts, not the dual-Zero scroll glitch, the supporting line’s size/gist, Best of all overlap, four-section count, or journey sentence formation.

cards.issue_title: The Zero-block supporting line is too small and does not say the gist
summary_4_lines: Under Zero commissions / Zero bias sits a small line: a fair view of every lender listed on the platform, none ranked or pushed ahead.
They said that line is very small, and “listed on a platform” could be said better.
The gist they wanted: a fair view of lenders in the market, ranked fairly, no one pushed forward, and no one can pay to change the ranking.
They asked for that gist in simple polished English, not big words.
cards.pinpoint: On the homepage Zero commissions / Zero bias block, the small supporting sentence is too small and “every lender listed on a platform” does not carry the gist they wanted: a fair view of all lenders in the market, ranked fairly, no one pushed forward, and no one can pay to change the ranking.
cards.on_screen_object: Supporting sentence under h2#home-zero-title: “So you get a fair view of every lender listed on our platform, with none ranked or pushed ahead of another.”
quotes_sample: every lender listed on a platform might have better wording.
the size of this sentence is very small.
fair view of lenders and no one has been pushed forward.
related_discussion_one_liners: The intended meaning of Zero commissions / Zero bias (issue 02) is the content they want this last sentence to carry.
“96% or 98% conversation can be done in just 300 words” is their bar for simple English.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the small supporting line under the Zero heading being too small and missing the fair-view / ranking-not-for-sale gist, not the dual-Zero scroll, the commissions/bias context mix, Best of all wording, four-section count, or journey sentences.

cards.issue_title: “Spam calls, a hard sell, or pushy notifications” overlap and their point is unclear
summary_4_lines: The Best of all line lists three things you will not get: spam calls, a hard sell, and pushy notifications.
They asked what those three are for, and how they differ.
Hard sell, spam, and WhatsApp pings overlap; the real promise they wanted was: no rush, look at your own pace, no extra calls, no buy/sell nags.
cards.pinpoint: On the homepage Best of all block, the trio “spam calls, a hard sell, or pushy notifications” is unclear: they asked what the three are for and how they differ; spam and hard sell overlap; the point they wanted was no urgency — look at your own pace, no extra calls, no buy/sell nags.
cards.on_screen_object: Best of all block: “without spam calls, a hard sell, or pushy notifications.” (main > div > section:nth-of-type(4) > … > p > span:nth-of-type(2))
quotes_sample: what is the significance of these three things? What is the difference between these three things?
Spam call and hard sell are a bit intersected.
related_discussion_one_liners: Hard sell = chasing documents you didn’t send.
Spam = selling data so others call; extra calls.
This block is one of the “four sections” they later ask to trim (issue 05).
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the Best of all trio (spam calls / hard sell / pushy notifications) overlapping and missing a clear no-urgency point, not Zero-block scroll or copy, not whether four story slides should be cut, and not journey sentence formation.

cards.issue_title: The four homepage story blocks may be too many — they asked if some can be cut
summary_4_lines: After walking the Zero and Best of all slides, they asked whether those four story sections are all needed.
They asked if some of them can be trimmed.
The next recording keeps that question: Transparent as a whole slide, Zero already said, Best of all already said.
cards.pinpoint: On the homepage, after Zero commissions and Best of all, they asked whether “these four sections” are all needed and whether some can be trimmed; that question continues on the next recording as whole slides that only repeat a quality.
cards.on_screen_object: The stacked homepage story sections: Transparent like never before; Zero commissions / Zero bias; Best of all / own pace; Built around you (and the re-engineered journey block they then treat as the story to keep)
quotes_sample: Now, I have a concern that these four sections do we need these four sections?
Can we trim some of these sections?
related_discussion_one_liners: They immediately sketch the re-engineered journey as a title plus three parts (issue 06).
2000: “I don't think we should do an entire slide” about Transparent; “Zero commission, zero bias. We have already said this.”
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is a structure/length question about whether all four homepage story slides are needed, separate from the wording of Zero, Best of all, or the journey sentences themselves.

cards.issue_title: “We completely re-engineered your home loan journey” is a coherent story, but the sentences are not
summary_4_lines: They kept that title and wanted three parts under it: market you can compare, unique information without giving your details, then apply once and the bank finishes.
They said the first part should be much bigger.
The story itself they called coherent; the wording and sentence formation they said is not.
cards.pinpoint: On the homepage re-engineered-journey block (#home-lead-title plus the three body sentences), they said the story is coherent but the word / sentence formation is not; they wanted a title plus three parts, with the first (market comparability / unique information) much bigger.
cards.on_screen_object: h2#home-lead-title “We completely re-engineered your home loan journey.” and the three body lines under it
quotes_sample: We have to keep a title and in that part, we have to show three sections.
The hope is to make the first section much bigger.
This is definitely a coherent story. But the word or the sentence formation is not that coherent.
related_discussion_one_liners: Unique information without giving your information; make you powerful/knowledgeable without taking anything in return; flip the game so the bank completes it.
“This is actually not a team point” (ASR twice) — related aside on what kind of point this is, not a second defect.
Standardized everything in one section; don’t give information until one shot to everyone.
2000 continues: this section has three things; then they judge Transparent as a whole extra slide (issue 05).
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the re-engineered journey title’s sentence formation not being coherent (keep title + three parts, first much bigger), not whether four story slides should be cut and not Zero or Best of all wording.
